s0.speaker: narrator
s0.text: As the great serpent sank, coil by coil, a strange light escaped her body. It rose... and drifted away, as if pulled by unseen hands.

s1.speaker: monk_voice
s1.text: Yes... yes. Bring it to me.

s2.speaker: kagami
s2.text: Tell the little one... the tide will hold... a while longer.

s3.speaker: narrator
s3.text: Something of her stays with you. Your feet remember the waves.  (POWER: TIDE STEP - dash twice in a row)
